name: slider
title: Slider
description: Pick a number or a range on a track. Single or range thumbs (one per value), optional visible label and live value readout, two sizes, works inside Field and Form. The optional invalid prop exposes aria-invalid on every thumb input and destructive thumb borders; invalid Field works without the prop. Pair invalid with a FieldError or description explaining the allowed values; colour alone is insufficient. Set withInput to pair each thumb with a kit NumberInput on a fixed grid row. Typing within the bounds updates the slider immediately; blur or Enter clamps and snaps to the nearest step from min (1.37 becomes 1.4 with min 0 and step 0.1). Empty or unparsable text restores the current value without a change callback. Range inputs also clamp against neighbouring thumbs and respect minStepsBetweenValues. The slider remains the only named form control; paired inputs are isolated from Field validation and share the slider or thumb name. showValue is hidden while paired. inputProps accepts unit, hideSteppers and size; input size defaults to the slider size (md by default). See SliderWithInput for single, controlled and range examples.
author: gntik-ai
